name: @ground-truth/retreever-who-what
description: Who / What directory pages. A CHILD: it takes its parent as props and stands alone without one.
_no_build_on_purpose: A child ships no vite.config.ts. It is not an app; it is a folder a parent builds. That is why the escape/case guard is a VITE PLUGIN in each parent (unskippable: no build, no deploy) and a VITEST TEST here (portable: runs in a bare clone with no app around it). Same rule, two shapes, because a plugin needs a build to hook into and a child has none.
_why_pinned: Versions match what ReTreever runs, because that is the version the code was written and tested against. They were all "*" until 25 Aug 2026, which is not a constraint but a wish: the workspace install resolved pbf to 5.1.2, which dropped the default export, and the build died on `import Pbf from "pbf"`. Nested inside a parent the child silently borrowed the parent's version and the hole never showed. A child that is genuinely portable has to state what it needs.
